ALL_72_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.role: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY -- not a confirmatory result

ambiguity_sensitivity_CORE.note: Sensitivity only. The confirmatory CORE analysis uses all 48 frozen labels; ambiguous cases are NOT excluded.

metric_definitions.DESCRIPTIVE_CorrectSilenceRate: SILENCE on valid_hints-empty scenarios / number of such scenarios; N/A when the denominator is zero
metric_definitions.PRIMARY_RelevantHintRate: relevant delivered hints / all attempted scenarios; SILENCE is ALWAYS a failure, including where valid_hints is empty
metric_definitions.RedundantWhenTeachable: redundant-and-teaching / teaching delivered; N/A when zero
metric_definitions.SECONDARY_AppropriateActionRate: (delivered AND selected in valid_hints) OR (SILENCE AND valid_hints empty), over all attempted; prospective, new in v4
metric_definitions.composite_score: none computed; systems are not ranked by an invented overall score
metric_definitions.redundancy_note: Human relevance and non-redundancy are different properties. A hint can be human-labelled relevant and still be counted redundant when it teaches a concept already DEMONSTRATED. No human label was rewritten to resolve that difference.

none_scenarios.note: NONE is a real annotation, not a missing one. Under the frozen PRIMARY metric a SILENCE here is still a relevance failure; under the SECONDARY metric it is correct. The distinction is intentional.

condition_c_transport_manifest.backoff_amendment: config declares transport_retry.backoff_seconds; the frozen selector counts retries without sleeping, so the delay is applied by a composition wrapper in the runner. No retry count, budget or abort condition is changed.
condition_c_transport_manifest.determinism: NOT claimed; sampling parameters are not controllable through this transport

strata.note: CORE and STRESS are never merged into a headline result
